source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. No year is printed; examYear 2025 is taken from the file name (...-070325-2025) and the icseboard.org folder. Printed: TIME: 2 HOURS, M.M. 80. Section marks are printed per question ([5], [5], [5], [5], [6], [7], [8], [30], [9]); where a section has as many items as marks each item is stored with 1 mark (SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS). Section III ([5] for three items) and the match-the-columns grid are single entries. Section VIII parts carry printed marks [1]/[2]/[2]; the six extracts are stored as VIII.1-VIII.6 with the extract repeated in each part. Section IX is 'Attempt any 3' of five (3 marks each, one choiceGroup). Underlined words are shown in [brackets]. Literature items refer to the class reader and are mapped to 'reading'. Handwriting on the scan is ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Match the columns:
Column A | Column B
i. Don't judge a book by its cover. | a) Go away
ii. Take a flak | b) I think
iii. Make | c) Receive a lot of negative feedback
iv. Begone | d) A wish
v. Methinks | e) Don't form opinion about somebody /something from their appearance

questions.sectionTitle: Complete these sentences.
questions.text:
Complete these sentences.
1. I've listened to a ....(diamond/ ruby) ring. I've waved a .... (Football/ Basketball) fan.
2. The film was so....(boring/ amazing) that we left at the interval.
3. It makes me sad when .... (cabbage/ lettuce) leaves. I .... (cry/ laugh) when dinner rolls.
extractionIssues: Marks [5] printed for the three items together; kept as one entry
